title: evolvulus pilosus
intro: Evolvulus pilosus, commonly known as Dwarf Blue Daze, is a species of flowering plant in the family Convolvulaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Evolvulus pilosus include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and sedative properties, which can help alleviate anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
